posts.title: Why Nobles is the No. 1 team in girls prep entering 2026-27
posts.description: Expectations are high at Nobles once again. It’s for good reason, too. Few were better last season, as the Bulldogs went 28-2-0, falling to eventual champion Loomis Chaffee in overtime of the Elite 8 semis. “We came up one goal short of getting to the finals and had a terrific year,” coach Tom Resor said. “You get that close and think about the little things that might’ve gone differently, but that’s the way hockey is.” Nobles has the team to get that close again. What’s more, the Bulldogs may just have the pieces to put them over the top, too, nabbing the No. 1 spot in our preseason girls prep rankings. What will it take to be the last ones standing?
